exposure: Site of umbilical cord entanglement (neck, trunk, limb)
cohort: 14,299 women who gave birth to a liveborn singleton newborn between 2014-2018
finding: While umbilical cord entanglement was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes during labor, these effects were not significant shortly after birth.
mod_finding: Umbilical cord entanglement was associated with an increased need for labor induction, operative vaginal delivery, and cesarean delivery.
